title: Competitor Analysis: Iberia Logistics
body_markdown:
Three competitors matter for Project Atlas in Portugal. All names are fictional.
- **Costa Rapid** — strong national coverage, weak same-day service
- **Tagus Freight** — low prices, limited tracking for customers
- **Iberia Express Group** — premium service, high minimum volumes
## Takeaway
Northwind Logistics can differentiate on real-time tracking and cold-chain delivery. Daniel Okafor will validate this in customer interviews.
